description: Body of `POST /api/v1/channels/{id}/uploads`: step 1 of an upload.

content_type.description: The declared content type (`type/subtype`, advice only; the server sniffs).

filename.description:
The file name. The server keeps the part after the last `/` or `\`, trims it, and
needs 1–255 bytes with no control characters (not `.` or `..`).

size.description: The size in bytes. Over `files.max_bytes` is `413 too_large`.

title: CreateUploadRequest
